scripts.dist:installer: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $stagingOut = '.\dist-installer-build-' + $stamp; npx electron-builder --win nsis --config.directories.output=$stagingOut; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw ('electron-builder failed with exit code ' + $LASTEXITCODE + '.') }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '.\dist-installer' -Force | Out-Null; $setup = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $stagingOut -Filter 'NexPlay Setup *.exe' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $setup) { throw 'NexPlay setup artifact was not found in staging output.' }; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $setup.FullName -Destination (Join-Path '.\dist-installer' $setup.Name) -Force; $blockMapPath = $setup.FullName + '.blockmap'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $blockMapPath) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $blockMapPath -Destination (Join-Path '.\dist-installer' ([IO.Path]::GetFileName($blockMapPath))) -Force }; $builderDebug = Join-Path $stagingOut 'builder-debug.yml'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $builderDebug) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $builderDebug -Destination '.\dist-installer\builder-debug.yml' -Force }"
scripts.make:uninstaller: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'dist' -Force | Out-Null; dotnet publish '.\tools\NexPlayUninstallerExe\NexPlayUninstallerExe.csproj' -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -p:DebugType=None -p:DebugSymbols=false -o '.\dist\uninstaller-exe'; Copy-Item -LiteralPath '.\dist\uninstaller-exe\NexPlayUninstaller.exe' -Destination '.\dist\NexPlay Uninstaller.exe' -Force"
scripts.make:updater: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $stagingOut = '.\dist-updater-build-' + $stamp; $payloadOut = '.\dist-updater-payload\win-unpacked'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '.\dist' -Force | Out-Null; & '.\node_modules\.bin\electron-builder.cmd' --win --dir --config.directories.output=$stagingOut; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw ('electron-builder failed with exit code ' + $LASTEXITCODE + '.') }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $payloadOut -Force | Out-Null; robocopy (Join-Path $stagingOut 'win-unpacked') $payloadOut /MIR /R:1 /W:1 /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ge 8) { throw ('robocopy failed with exit code ' + $LASTEXITCODE + '.') }; $env:APPDATA = (Join-Path (Resolve-Path '.').ProviderPath '.build-appdata'); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $env:APPDATA -Force | Out-Null; $userNuGetPackages = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.nuget\packages'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $userNuGetPackages) { $env:NUGET_PACKAGES = $userNuGetPackages }; dotnet restore '.\tools\NexPlayUpdaterExe\NexPlayUpdaterExe.csproj' -r win-x64 --configfile '.\NuGet.Config' --ignore-failed-sources; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw ('dotnet restore failed with exit code ' + $LASTEXITCODE + '.') }; dotnet publish '.\tools\NexPlayUpdaterExe\NexPlayUpdaterExe.csproj' -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true --no-restore -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -p:DebugType=None -p:DebugSymbols=false -o '.\dist\updater-exe'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw ('dotnet publish failed with exit code ' + $LASTEXITCODE + '.') }; Copy-Item -LiteralPath '.\dist\updater-exe\NexPlayUpdater.exe' -Destination '.\dist\NexPlay Updater.exe' -Force"
scripts.make:uninstaller-script: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'dist\scripts' -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'NexPlay-Uninstall.cmd' -Destination 'dist\NexPlay Uninstaller.cmd' -Force; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'scripts\uninstall-nexplay.ps1' -Destination 'dist\scripts\uninstall-nexplay.ps1' -Force"
